description_en: Queries the information about a global active database cluster or information about all global active database clusters in a region
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS MySQL全球多活数据库集群列表或目标集群的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-gad-instances --gad-instance-name gad-rm-bp1npi2j80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGadInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the global active database cluster.

If you leave this parameter empty, this operation returns the details about all global active database clusters that are created within your Alibaba Cloud account.
If you specify this parameter, this operation returns the details about the global active database cluster that you specify.

If you do not specify this parameter when you call this operation for the first time, the IDs of all clusters that are created by using the current account are returned. Then, you can specify the cluster ID to view the cluster details
parameters.help_zh:
RDS全球多活数据库集群ID。
不传入该参数返回当前账号下的所有集群ID。
传入该参数返回目标集群的详细信息。


您可在第一次调用时不传入此参数获取当前账号下的所有集群ID，再通过传入集群ID查看该集群的详情
parameters.name: gad_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

GadInstances.description_en: The details about the global active database cluster
GadInstances.description_zh: RDS全球多活数据库集群信息列表

items.description_zh: RDS全球多活数据库集群详细信息

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the global active database cluster was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 集群的创建时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

GadInstanceMembers.description_en: The information about each node in the cluster
GadInstanceMembers.description_zh: 集群中各节点信息列表

items.description_zh: 集群中各节点详细信息

DtsInstance.description_en:
A JSON array that consists of the details about the Data Transmission Service (DTS) synchronization task.

Each unit node (secondary node) synchronizes data from the central node (primary node) by using DTS. This parameter contains the synchronization link ID and request ID of DTS
DtsInstance.description_zh:
包含DTS同步信息的JSON数组。
每个单元节点（备节点）都会通过DTS和中心节点（主节点）进行数据同步，该参数中包含了DTS的同步链路ID和请求ID

Engine.description_en:
The database engine that is run by the node.

The value of this parameter is fixed as mysql
Engine.description_zh:
集群中节点的数据库引擎。
当前仅支持mysql

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version that is run by the node
EngineVersion.description_zh: 集群中节点的数据库版本

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the node resides
RegionId.description_zh: 集群中节点所在的地域ID

Role.description_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

CENTRAL: The node is a central node. Each global active database cluster has only one central node. All unit nodes synchronize data from the central node.
UNIT: The node is a unit node. Each global active database cluster can have up to 10 unit nodes. All unit nodes synchronize data from the central node
Role.description_zh:
RDS全球多活数据库集群中的节点类型。返回值：
CENTRAL：中心节点，集群中的唯一主节点，所有单元节点的数据都从该节点同步。
UNIT：单元节点，一个集群中可以有10个单元节点，所有单元节点都从中心节点同步数据

Status.description_en:
The node status. Valid values:

activation: The node is running.
creating: The node is being created
Status.description_zh:
节点状态。取值：
activation：运行中。
creating：创建中

GadInstanceName.description_en: The ID of the global active database cluster
GadInstanceName.description_zh: RDS全球多活数据库集群的ID

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the most recent modification was made to the global active database cluster. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModificationTime.description_zh: 最后一次变更集群的时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Service.description_en:
The database engine that is run by the global active database cluster.

The value of this parameter is fixed as mysql
Service.description_zh:
RDS全球多活数据库集群的引擎。
当前仅支持mysql

Status.description_en:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:

activation: The cluster is running.
creating: The cluster is being created.
replica_adding: Nodes are being added to the cluster
Status.description_zh:
集群状态。取值：
activation：运行中。
creating：创建中。
replica_adding：添加节点中
